events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: A café-inspired public fragrance experience for the launch of COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU, with personalized fragrance discovery, the wider COCO MADEMOISELLE line, CHANEL hair/body products, makeup and on-site shopping.
events.what_is_free: Admission and the fragrance-discovery experience are free. Products are available to purchase; no free take-home product is promised to every visitor.
events.caveats: CHANEL states that appointments are limited but walk-ins are encouraged during event hours. An appointment is therefore optional rather than an approval requirement or guaranteed-admission claim. Normal capacity can still apply.
events.practical_notes: September 11 from noon–7 PM; September 12–13 from 10 AM–7 PM; September 18 from noon–7 PM; September 19–20 from 10 AM–7 PM. Use CHANEL's official event page for current appointment availability.

events.brand: White House Black Market × Saint Coffee
events.address: Saint Coffee, 201 7th Ave, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW coffee stop from White House Black Market at Saint Coffee with a fall-collection preview.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise complimentary coffee, black-and-white cookies and a signature WHBM shirt to take home; promotional inventory is subject to availability.
events.caveats: NYC Plugged explicitly describes the activation as open to the public. No advance RSVP, ticket, purchase or host-approval requirement is published in the verified listings. Free items can run out.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 from 8 AM–1 PM at Saint Coffee, 201 Seventh Avenue.

events.event_name: Guest House: Welcome Home at The Wang Contemporary
events.what_it_is: A free exhibition of life-size wax sculptures by Zhou Xuerong that places familiar female American pop-culture icons in distinctly Chinese settings, marking the artist's U.S. institutional debut.
events.what_is_free: Public exhibition admission is free. Current event listings also advertise a free reservation path, but the exhibition itself is described as free and open to the public.
events.caveats: Multiple current sources describe the exhibition as free and open to the public. Sources conflict on whether opening-day hours begin at 11 AM or noon, so only the narrower noon–6 PM opening-day window is published here. The broader recurring weekend schedule is not converted into additional dated cards until its date-specific hours are more firmly reconciled.
events.practical_notes: Opening day, Friday September 11, is safely verified for noon–6 PM at 58 Bowery. Sources say the exhibition continues on weekends through September 27.
